record.context_brief: Distance between H1 homotopy classes on S2
record.original_question:
For homotopy classes E_d={f∈H^1(S^2;S^2):deg f=d}, define Dist_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})=\sup_{f∈E_{d_1}}\inf_{g∈E_{d_2}}\|
abla(f-g)\|_{L^2}. Is it true that Dist_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})^2=8π|d_1-d_2| for all integers d_1,d_2? Even more basically, is this distance symmetric in the two classes?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5.9 ([27]). Is it true that Dist2_H1 (Ed1, Ed2) = 8π |d1 − d2| for all d1, d2 ∈ Z? ... Even a much easier problem is open: is it true that Dist_H1(Ed1, Ed2) = Dist_H1(Ed2, Ed1) for all d1, d2 ∈ Z?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^2$ denote the standard unit sphere in $\mathbb{R}^3$. For a map $f\in H^1(S^2;S^2)$ (i.e., $f\in H^1(S^2;\mathbb{R}^3)$ with $|f(x)|=1$ a.e.), the Brouwer degree $\deg f\in\mathbb{Z}$ is well defined. For each $d\in\mathbb{Z}$ set
$$E_d=\{f\in H^1(S^2;S^2):\deg f=d\}.$$
For $d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}$ define the (in general asymmetric) $H^1$-distance between homotopy classes by
$$\operatorname{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})=\sup_{f\in E_{d_1}}\inf_{g\in E_{d_2}}\|\nabla(f-g)\|_{L^2(S^2)}.$$

(a) Decide whether
$$\operatorname{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})^2=8\pi\,|d_1-d_2|\qquad\text{for all }d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}.$$

(b) Decide the weaker symmetry question: is it true that
$$\operatorname{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_1},E_{d_2})=\operatorname{Dist}_{H^1}(E_{d_2},E_{d_1})\qquad\text{for all }d_1,d_2\in\mathbb{Z}?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in the literature on distances between homotopy classes of Sobolev maps between spheres. Related results are known for $W^{1,p}(S^n;S^n)$ with $p>n$ (where the distance between distinct classes equals a universal positive constant), but the precise value $8\pi|d_1-d_2|$ and even the symmetry of $\operatorname{Dist}_{H^1}$ in the critical $H^1=W^{1,2}$ case on $S^2$ are not known to be resolved.

status_evidence.title: On the distance between homotopy classes of maps between spheres
status_evidence.snippet: In W^{1,p}(S^n,S^n) with p>n the distance between distinct homotopy classes equals a universal positive constant.
status_evidence.claim: Related supercritical case is settled, but the critical case p=n=2 with the conjectured formula 8π|d_1-d_2| remains an open question.

status_evidence.title: New questions related to the topological degree (H. Brezis)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open questions about degree and distances between homotopy classes in Sobolev spaces of sphere-valued maps.
status_evidence.claim: The question is posed as an open problem by Brezis.
